descriptors.concept_name: Manner Of Selection Of Independent Directors And Maintenance Of Data Bank Of Independent Directors [Section 150]
descriptors.definition: Eligible individuals seeking appointments as independent directors must apply online to an authorized institute for inclusion in a maintained data bank. Names within the data bank must be periodically renewed for specified durations ranging from one year to life-time.
instrument_references: Rule 6 of the Companies (Appointment and Qualifications of Directors) Rules, 2014
inclusion: Online application for data bank inclusion
Voluntary application by individuals without DIN
Renewal applications filed within thirty days of expiry
exclusion: Direct appointments bypassing data bank registration where mandatory
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from general director appointments under regular qualification guidelines.

descriptors.definition: Directors must act honestly, diligently, and in good faith to promote company objects and stakeholder wealth maximization. They are prohibited from assigning their office or exploiting corporate business opportunities for personal advantage.
inclusion: Acting in accordance with company articles
Exercising independent judgment with reasonable care
Liability to pay equal amounts for any undue gains made
exclusion: Permissible delegation of operational duties to staff members
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from assignment of office which is void, whereas delegation of tasks is permissible.

descriptors.definition: A director's office automatically becomes vacant upon the occurrence of specific statutory disqualifications or prolonged unexcused absences from board meetings. Additional vacation triggers include contract interest non-disclosures, tribunal disqualification orders, or criminal convictions resulting in imprisonment.
inclusion: Absence from all board meetings for twelve consecutive months
Conviction with a sentence of six months or more
Cessation of employment in a holding, subsidiary, or associate company
exclusion: Immediate vacation during statutory grace periods allowed for pending appeals against court orders
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from voluntary resignation and shareholder removal processes.

descriptors.definition: A director may resign by serving a written notice to the company, which takes effect from the date of receipt or a specified later date. The company must intimate the registrar regarding the resignation while the departing director remains liable for offences occurring during their tenure.
instrument_references: Rule 15 and Rule 16 of the Companies (Appointment and Qualifications of Directors) Rules, 2014
inclusion: Written notice served to the company
Filing obligations through electronic statutory forms
Continued accountability for past tenure offences
exclusion: Discharge from liabilities accrued after the effective date of resignation
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from vacation of office and removal by shareholders.

descriptors.definition: Shareholders may remove a director before completing their term by passing an ordinary or special resolution after providing a reasonable opportunity of being heard. Special notices signed by qualifying members are required to propose such removal resolutions.
inclusion: Removal by ordinary resolution before term expiry
Special resolution requirement for re-appointed independent directors
Special notice backed by specified voting power or paid-up share capital thresholds
exclusion: Directors appointed by the Tribunal or via proportional representation systems
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from vacation of office occurring automatically by operation of law.

descriptors.concept_name: Register Of Directors And Key Managerial Personnel And Their Shareholding [Section 170]
descriptors.definition: Companies must maintain a register at their registered office containing detailed personal and professional particulars of directors and key managerial personnel. The register must also record comprehensive transactional details regarding securities held by them across the company and its group entities.
instrument_references: Rule 17 of the Companies (Appointment and Qualifications of Directors) Rules, 2014
inclusion: Personal particulars such as names, dates of birth, and addresses
Nominal values, acquisition dates, and prices of securities
Modes of holding securities in physical or dematerialized form
exclusion: Mandatory DIN requirement for key managerial personnel where PAN acts as an alternative
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from annual returns by focusing specifically on managerial personnel profiles and cross-entity security transactions.

descriptors.definition: Company members possess the statutory right to inspect the register of directors and key managerial personnel during business hours and at annual general meetings. Requested extracts and copies must be supplied free of cost within a specified timeframe.
inclusion: Inspection access during business hours
Availability of the register at every annual general meeting
Registrar intervention and order powers upon refusal of inspection
exclusion: Exempted government companies meeting compliant filing conditions
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from general corporate record access by its specific applicability to managerial registers.

descriptors.definition: Contraventions of chapter provisions regarding management appointments and qualifications carry monetary penalties for the company and defaulting officers. Continuing failures attract daily incremental fines up to specified statutory maximum limits.
inclusion: Fixed initial penalty for non-compliance
Daily penalties for continuing defaults subject to upper caps
Compounding provisions applicable to defaulting entities and officers
exclusion: Specific punishments already provided under separate sections within the chapter
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished as a residual penalty clause when no specific punishment is outlined elsewhere in the chapter.
